problem: ModuleContribution imports a presentation-layer protocol and ModuleRegistry constructs PresentationRegistry. This reverses the dependency direction: installed modules should contribute neutral adapter objects, while application composition should construct the presentation subsystem.

options.name: Keep ModuleRegistry as presentation factory
options.correctness: Preserves current API but retains modules to presentation coupling and the 9-package SCC.

options.name: Expose neutral adapters and compose PresentationRegistry outside modules
options.correctness: Keeps one adapter protocol and one PresentationRegistry authority while restoring the dependency direction from presentation/composition toward module contributions.
options.complexity: Eight governed paths including compatibility export, composition caller, module installation regression and architecture record.
options.migration: Move the structural adapter protocol to the module contribution contract, re-export it from presentation.adapters, expose presentation_adapters() from ModuleRegistry, and construct PresentationRegistry in Composition Root and the presentation fallback.
options.rollback: Restore PresentationAdapter import and build_presentation_registry() in modules.
options.verification: Architecture Gate, module installation tests, full Quick, lifecycle and Chromium.

options.name: Create a new generic plugin contract package
options.correctness: Could remove the edge but introduces another package and migration surface for one small structural protocol.
options.migration: Create package, move protocol, update all imports and public APIs.

rejected_reasons.keep-module-built-presentation-registry: It preserves the wrong dependency direction and blocks modules from leaving the SCC.
rejected_reasons.create-new-cross-layer-plugin-package: A new package would add more architecture than the single structural contract requires.

deletions: Delete modules imports of agent_core.presentation and delete ModuleRegistry.build_presentation_registry; preserve agent_core.presentation.adapters.PresentationAdapter as a compatibility re-export.
unknowns: The remaining 8-package SCC remains open debt.
Real model certification remains outside this structural migration.
selected_responsibilities: agent_core.modules owns the neutral module contribution shape and adapter collection.
agent_core.presentation owns PresentationRegistry behavior and release contracts.
agent_core.composition owns construction of PresentationRegistry from installed module adapters.
preserved_hard_invariants: There remains exactly one PresentationAdapter structural protocol and one PresentationRegistry implementation.
Presentation priorities, contracts, renderers and release behavior remain unchanged.
kernel, resources, ledger, rag and utils remain outside the main SCC.
The dependency debt baseline is not edited.
cutover_strategy: Record expected-red, move only the structural protocol ownership, replace ModuleRegistry factory behavior with adapter collection, update Composition Root and fallback construction, then run complete product verification.
acceptance_claims: modules imports no presentation package and is absent from the main SCC.
PresentationRegistry is constructed only by presentation/composition callers from ModuleRegistry.presentation_adapters().
The current SCC member count is at most 8.
Module installation, startup, transaction, frontend, lifecycle and browser behavior remain green.
